name: CG · 02 Content Pipeline
description: Core sub-workflow: validates a topic request, plans a diverse variation from run history, writes a 500-800 word piece with a quality gate, generates an image, saves files and logs the run.

parameters.jsCode:
const ctx = $json.ctx;
const config = $('Validate Request').first().json.config;
const M = config.models.text;
const Q = config.quality;
const style = config.styles[ctx.plan.style];
const plan = ctx.plan;
const brief = ctx.brief;
const revising = Boolean(ctx.article && ctx.article.issues.length);

const system = [
  'You are an expert writer producing original, accurate and well-structured content in Markdown.',
  'Never invent statistics, survey results, quotes, named sources, prices or dates. If a figure is not common knowledge, describe its magnitude qualitatively.',
  'Do not include links, images, tables, footnotes or placeholder text, and never mention the brief or that you are an AI.',
  'Never use these phrases: ' + Q.banned_phrases.join('; ') + '.'
].join('\n');

const prompt = revising
  ? [
      'Revise this ' + style.label.toLowerCase() + ' to fix the problems listed. Keep everything that already works: title, angle, structure and voice.',
      '',
      'Problems to fix:',
      ...ctx.article.issues.map(issue => '- ' + issue),
      '',
      'The final length must be between ' + Q.min_words + ' and ' + Q.max_words + ' words (aim for ' + ctx.request.word_target + ').',
      'Return only the full revised article body in Markdown, without a title heading.',
      '',
      'Current draft:',
      '',
      ctx.article.markdown
    ].join('\n')
  : [
      'Write the ' + style.label.toLowerCase() + ' planned below.',
      '',
      'Title (shown above the article; do not repeat it): ' + brief.title,
      'Core message: ' + brief.thesis,
      'Audience: ' + plan.audience.text,
      'Tone: ' + plan.tone,
      'Angle: ' + plan.angle.text,
      'Opening: ' + plan.hook.text,
      '',
      'Required structure for this format:',
      ...style.structure.map(item => '- ' + item),
      'Format rules:',
      ...style.rules.map(rule => '- ' + rule),
      '',
      'Outline (use these as the ## section headings, in this order; you may polish the wording):',
      ...brief.sections.map(s => '- ' + s.heading + ' (' + s.key_points.join('; ') + ')'),
      '',
      'Length: about ' + ctx.request.word_target + ' words, never below ' + Q.min_words + ' or above ' + Q.max_words + '.',
      'Markdown rules: no # title heading; use ## for section headings; keep every paragraph under ' + Q.max_paragraph_words + ' words; use bullet lists only where they help; use bold sparingly.',
      'Return only the article body in Markdown.'
    ].join('\n');

return {
  json: {
    purpose: revising ? 'revision' : 'article',
    models: { primary: M.primary, fallback: M.fallback },
    system,
    prompt,
    temperature: 1,
    max_output_tokens: 8192,
    thinking_level: M.thinking_level,
    timeout_ms: M.timeouts_ms.article,
    deadline_at: ctx.run.deadline_at,
    pricing: config.pricing_usd_per_million_tokens,
    simulate_primary_fail: ctx.run.simulate.text_primary_fail,
    passthrough: ctx
  }
};

parameters.content:
## CG · 02 Content Pipeline
Turns one topic into a 500-800 word piece plus an AI image. Called by **CG · 01 Intake** (webhook + form) and **CG · 03 Batch Runner**.

1. **Validate & plan**: load config, validate input, read recent runs, choose style / angle / hook / audience / visuals for diversity.
2. **Brief**: JSON-schema outline + title novelty check (regenerates once).
3. **Write & quality gate**: draft, deterministic checks, up to 2 targeted revisions.
4. **Illustrate**: image from the brief's concept + planned visual style.
5. **Finalize & persist**: outputs/<run_id>.md, .jpg and .json, a row in content_runs, and the result.

Status: success, needs_review, partial (no image), failed, rejected. One 280 s deadline is shared by every model call.

nodeGroups.name: Validate & plan
nodeGroups.description: Loads config, validates the request (rejects bad input), reads recent runs, plans style/angle/hook/audience/visuals and reserves the plan.

nodeGroups.name: Brief
nodeGroups.description: Plans the piece as schema-validated JSON (title, thesis, outline, image concept); regenerates once if the title repeats a recent one.

nodeGroups.name: Write & quality gate
nodeGroups.description: Writes the draft, scores it with deterministic checks and runs up to 2 targeted revisions within the time budget.

nodeGroups.name: Illustrate
nodeGroups.description: Builds an image prompt from the brief and the planned visual style, then calls the image gateway (fallback inside).

nodeGroups.name: Finalize & persist
nodeGroups.description: Sets the run status, writes <run_id>.md, .jpg and .json to outputs/, logs the run to content_runs and returns the result.
